asr_text: Today, we look at personalized news feeds and the way they shape what people see each day. These feeds can make it easier to find relevant stories, but they also raise questions about what may stay out of view and who decides what matters. By the end, you will understand the main question behind this experience: How much should a news feed choose for us?
